name: Ty ne odin
source: A visual novel that plunges you into the everyday life of students. Along the way, it explores themes like academic stress, parental expectations, family troubles, and the challenge of finding your true calling. Your mission is to help each character face and overcome their personal struggles.
translation: 一部带你走进学生日常生活的视觉小说。一路上，它探讨了诸如学业压力、父母期望、家庭问题以及找到真正使命的挑战等主题。你的任务是帮助每个角色面对并克服他们的个人挣扎。
